question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is __**while**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"while" **is used when some particular point of time is addressed.
 
• Example : I like to watch T.V **while **eating food.
 
• The **meaning** of above sentence is that for sports persons during recreation activities heart exhaustion is a common recreational hazard due to heat trapping in their clothes and raising body temperature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **"while"** is a conjunction.
 
• The **conjunction** is a word that is used to connect words or phrases , Ex - but , because , or
 
• Example in sentences : I like coffee **but** when it is hot.
